title: What my Zylo spec forgot: 31/31 checks passed, 6 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a Zylo alternative, a SaaS spend tracker that warns each tool's owner 30 days before the last day to cancel, from one written spec. All 31 acceptance checks passed, but the spec never said where a late cancellation goes in the history. That was one of 6 gaps the build exposed, and all 6 are now fixed in the spec.

Not tested: production sign-in, real email delivery, the daily job on a real scheduler, and hosting.

Full build test (2:46): https://youtu.be/m8hlTu5_bkY
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/saas-spend-tracker
Zylo pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/zylo

Zylo does not publish prices: Core, Premium and Enterprise are sold by quote (zylo.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
